text: account.frequency is the statement issuance frequency: 'POPLATEK MESICNE' = monthly issuance, 'POPLATEK TYDNE' = weekly issuance, 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU' = issuance after a transaction.
How often an account's statement is issued, released or requested is account.frequency (not a count of transactions).
loan.status: 'A' = contract finished, no problems; 'B' = contract finished, loan not paid; 'C' = running contract, OK so far; 'D' = running contract, client in debt.
trans.type is the direction: 'PRIJEM' = credit (money in), 'VYDAJ' = withdrawal/debit (a few rows hold 'VYBER'). trans.amount is always positive; the sign comes only from trans.type.

trans.operation: 'VYBER KARTOU' = credit card withdrawal, 'VKLAD' = credit in cash, 'PREVOD Z UCTU' = collection from another bank, 'VYBER' = withdrawal in cash, 'PREVOD NA UCET' = remittance to another bank.
A withdrawal in cash is trans.operation = 'VYBER'; a card withdrawal is trans.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'; a withdrawal in general is trans.type = 'VYDAJ'.

trans.k_symbol: 'POJISTNE' insurance payment, 'SLUZBY' payment for statement, 'UROK' interest credited, 'SANKC. UROK' sanction interest for negative balance, 'SIPO' household, 'DUCHOD' old-age pension, 'UVER' loan payment.
order.k_symbol is the purpose (aim) of a debited payment order: 'POJISTNE' insurance, 'SIPO' household, 'LEASING' leasing, 'UVER' loan payment, '' unspecified. order.amount is the debited amount.
disp.type is 'OWNER' or 'DISPONENT' (authorized user). Only the OWNER can issue permanent orders or apply for loans, so a client eligible for loans has disp.type = 'OWNER'.
card.type: 'junior' = junior class card, 'classic' = standard class card, 'gold' = high-level credit card.
district.A2 is the district (branch location) name, e.g. 'Hl.m. Praha' for Prague; district.A3 is the region.
district.A3 regions are stored as 'Prague', 'central Bohemia', 'south Bohemia', 'west Bohemia', 'north Bohemia', 'east Bohemia', 'south Moravia', 'north Moravia' (direction word lowercase).

district.A4 = number of inhabitants (stored as TEXT); A5, A6, A7, A8 = number of municipalities with <499, 500-1999, 2000-9999, >10000 inhabitants; A10 = ratio of urban inhabitants; A11 = average salary.
district.A12 and A13 = unemployment rate in 1995 and 1996; A14 = entrepreneurs per 1000 inhabitants; A15 and A16 = number of committed crimes in 1995 and 1996. A9 is not useful.
The percentage increment of the unemployment rate from 1995 to 1996 is (district.A13 - district.A12) * 100 / district.A12.
Dates (account.date, card.issued, loan.date, trans.date, client.birth_date) are stored as 'YYYY-MM-DD' text, although the descriptions say YYMMDD.
A client's age is the difference in calendar years: strftime('%Y', reference date) - strftime('%Y', client.birth_date), with the current date as reference when none is given.
An account's branch/district is account.district_id; loans and transactions take their district through the account. Clients link to accounts only through disp (disp.client_id, disp.account_id).
